fullPassage: Just as stories are present in all cultural groups, they also have the potential to support the whole child across diverse areas and contexts. Stories are widely recognized for the role they play in helping young children develop language and literacy. Listening to stories and having conversations about stories helps children learn new vocabulary, solve problems, develop language and new language competencies, and refine their thinking. Through stories, children learn contextualized language while interacting with adults and decontextualized language individually in the context of telling stories or explaining their thoughts. Storytelling, story reading, and story play are widely recognized as experiences that support children's literacy development in the home environment, in schools, and in childcare settings. Studies confirming the benefits of children's exposure to stories for cognitive skills such as reading readiness, comprehension, and logical thought abound, but the influence of narratives surpasses the boundaries of language arts.

(B) After finishing their homework, the children went outside to <u>play</u> in the park with their friends.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 play의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) play a role = (역할을) 하다, 수행하다 / (B) play in the park = (밖에서) 놀다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 놀다 — (B) (역할을) 하다: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
✅ ② (A) (역할을) 하다 — (B) 놀다: (A)는 play a role로 '역할을 하다', (B)는 아이들이 공원에서 '놀다' ←정답
❌ ③ (A) (역할을) 하다 — (B) 연주하다: (B)는 악기를 '연주하다'가 아니라 '놀다'
❌ ④ (A) 연기하다 — (B) 놀다: (A)의 play는 '역할을 하다'이지 '연기하다'가 아님
det.tip: play: (역할을) 하다 / 놀다 / 연주하다 — 문맥으로 구별

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to read and write"

det.korean: 읽고 쓰는 능력 → literacy(문해력)
det.analysis:
✅ ① literacy(문해력) — 읽고 쓰는 능력 그 자체 ←정답
❌ ② vocabulary(어휘) — 아는 단어의 집합이지 읽고 쓰는 능력 전반이 아님
❌ ③ competency(역량) — 특정 분야의 능력을 뜻해 정의와 정확히 맞지 않음
❌ ④ comprehension(이해력) — 이해하는 능력이지 '읽고 쓰기'는 아님
det.tip: literacy = 읽고 쓰는 능력(문해력)

questions.passage: Through stories, children learn contextualized language while __________ (interact) with adults and decontextualized language individually in the context of telling stories or explaining their thoughts. Storytelling, story reading, and story play are widely recognized as experiences that support children's literacy development in the home environment, in schools, and in childcare settings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 접속사 while 뒤에서 주어(children)와 능동 관계이므로 「while + V-ing」 분사구문으로 interact를 interacting으로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: 빈칸은 접속사 while 바로 뒤예요. 이때 주어(children)가 스스로 '상호작용하는' 능동 관계라서 「while + 동사ing」 형태로 써요. 그래서 interact를 interacting으로 바꿔요. '어른과 상호작용하면서'라는 뜻이 돼요.
det.tip: while + V-ing(interacting) = ~하면서 (분사구문)

questions.passage: Storytelling, story reading, and story play are widely recognized as experiences that support children's literacy development in the home environment, in schools, and in childcare settings. Studies confirming the benefits of children's exposure to stories for cognitive skills such as reading readiness, comprehension, and __________ (logic) thought abound, but the influence of narratives surpasses the boundaries of language arts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 명사 thought(사고)를 앞에서 꾸미는 자리이므로 명사 logic을 형용사 logical로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤 thought(사고)는 명사예요. 명사를 앞에서 꾸미는 것은 형용사이므로 명사 logic(논리)을 형용사 logical(논리적인)로 바꿔요. reading readiness, comprehension과 나란히 놓이는 '논리적 사고(logical thought)'가 돼요.
det.tip: logic(논리, 명사) → logical(논리적인, 형용사): 명사 thought 수식

questions.passage: Just as stories are present in all cultural groups, they also have the potential to support __________ across diverse areas and contexts. Stories are widely recognized for the role they play in helping young children develop language and literacy. Listening to stories and having conversations about stories helps children learn new vocabulary, solve problems, develop language and new language competencies, and refine their thinking. Through stories, children learn contextualized language while interacting with adults and decontextualized language individually in the context of telling stories or explaining their thoughts. Storytelling, story reading, and story play are widely recognized as experiences that support children's literacy development in the home environment, in schools, and in childcare settings. Studies confirming the benefits of children's exposure to stories for cognitive skills such as reading readiness, comprehension, and logical thought abound, but the influence of narratives surpasses the boundaries of language arts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이야기는 다양한 영역과 맥락에 걸쳐 '아이 전체(the whole child)'를 지원할 잠재력을 지닌다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a single subject(한 과목) — 다양한 영역에 걸친다는 뒤 내용과 반대
❌ ② their own teachers(자기 교사들) — 지원 대상이 교사가 아니라 아이임
❌ ③ the local school(지역 학교) — 지원 대상이 학교가 아니라 아이임
✅ ④ the whole child(아이 전체) — 다양한 영역과 맥락에 걸쳐 아이 전체를 지원 ←정답
det.tip: support the whole child = 아이의 전인적 성장을 지원하다

questions.passage: Just as stories are present in all cultural groups, they also have the potential to support the whole child across diverse areas and contexts. Stories are widely recognized for the role they play in helping young children develop language and literacy. Listening to stories and having conversations about stories helps children learn new vocabulary, solve problems, develop language and new language competencies, and refine their thinking. Through stories, children learn contextualized language while interacting with adults and decontextualized language individually in the context of telling stories or explaining their thoughts. Storytelling, story reading, and story play are widely recognized as experiences that support children's literacy development in the home environment, in schools, and in childcare settings. Studies confirming the benefits of children's exposure to stories for cognitive skills such as reading readiness, comprehension, and logical thought abound, but the influence of narratives surpasses __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 서사의 영향력이 단순히 국어(언어 예술)의 범위에 머무르지 않고 '국어과의 경계(the boundaries of language arts)'를 넘어선다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the length of the stories(이야기의 길이) — '넘어선다'의 대상으로 문맥에 안 맞음
❌ ② the interest of young readers(어린 독자의 흥미) — 본문에 없는 내용
✅ ③ the boundaries of language arts(국어과의 경계) — 인지 능력 연구가 많지만 영향은 국어과를 넘어선다는 흐름 ←정답
❌ ④ the limits of their memory(기억의 한계) — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: surpasses the boundaries of language arts = 국어과의 경계를 넘어선다
